mentions.name: DitchSpam
mentions.description: This service generates temporary phone numbers (1-30 day validity) specifically for enquiry and quote forms. Users give out the temp number instead of their real one, receive calls and SMS in a dashboard, and the number auto-expires so telemarketers hit a dead end — preventing contact data from being sold into telemarketing databases.
mentions.problem: Filling out quote forms (insurance, home services, loans, B2B demos) feeds your number into lead-selling ecosystems, resulting in 5-50 spam calls per day that DND and Truecaller can't block because they come from real call-center numbers.
mentions.audience: Anyone in the US, UK, or Canada who fills out high-intent forms (insurance, home services, loans, B2B demos) and wants to avoid the spam-call spiral that follows.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Building DitchSpam (https://ditchspam.com) - temporary phone numbers specifically for enquiry forms.
The problem: every time you fill out a quote form (insurance, home services, loans, B2B demos), your number enters a lead-selling ecosystem.
